name: @singularity/plugin-apps-deploy-analytics-collect
description: Cookieless visit analytics that ship inside a deployed site: the collect/query contracts, closed dimension and family lists, the recorded-field manifest, the ingest endpoint (daily-salted visitor hash, 30-minute visits), the 90-day raw tables, the forever daily totals at every single-filter level, the nightly rollup and the host-only report query.
